chunks: The day when they will come out (of their graves), with nothing of them hidden from God. Whose then will be the kingdom? -- God's, the one, the omnipotent.
ai.seo_question: Who holds the kingdom on the Day of Resurrection according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ghafir, this verse emphasizes the transition from the hidden secrets of the worldly life to the absolute transparency of the Hereafter, where every individual is fully exposed before the Divine. It reinforces the concept of Tawhid al-Mulk (Oneness of Sovereignty), asserting that Allah’s absolute power and judgment are unchallenged, a theme central to Shia theological reflections on divine justice and the ultimate accountability of all creation.
